_comment: Round 3 (LLM analyst proposal, verified by the engine). Same price terms as round 2, but the candidate set is reshaped so that the search can afford its later phases: the first rich model crosses every categorical key with every base feature, and in rounds 1-2 (as in the frozen run) that alone used up the work budget, so pruning, the forward phase and the customer-rate search were skipped. (a) the site text is normalised (Hamamatsu: ward dropped, town kept; elsewhere city/town) and site_town is emptied, so towns enter as keyword flags of the site text in the forward phase rather than as a 27-level key on every feature; (b) height_mm is kept only for channel letters (character height), for panels the size already enters through the area; (c) work_budget 240 G (deterministic) instead of 120 G.

derived.removal: if_(contains(remarks, '撤去') and not contains(remarks, '撤去は別途'), 1, 0)
derived.disposal: if_(contains(remarks, '処分', '産廃') and not contains(remarks, '処分不要', '処分は先方'), 1, 0)
derived.survey: if_(contains(remarks, '現調', '現地調査') and not contains(remarks, '不要'), 1, 0)
derived.no_eyelets: if_(contains(remarks, 'ハトメ不要', 'ハトメなし'), 1, 0)
derived.yield36: max(floor(910 / short_mm) * floor(1820 / long_mm), floor(910 / long_mm) * floor(1820 / short_mm))
derived.yield48: max(floor(1220 / short_mm) * floor(2440 / long_mm), floor(1220 / long_mm) * floor(2440 / short_mm))
derived.eyelets: if_((media == 'ターポリン') and (no_eyelets == 0), 2 * (ceil(width_mm / 500) + ceil(height_mm / 500)) * qty, 0)
derived.site: if_(contains(site, '浜松市'), concat('浜松市', regex(site, '区(.+)$', 1, '')), regex(site, '^\s*((?:東京都|北海道|(?:京都|大阪)府|.{2,3}?県)?.+?[市区町村])', 1, ''))
